اختلجا (form VIII)
# اِخْتَلَجَا (iḵtalajā) /ix.ta.la.d͡ʒaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِخْتَلَجَ (iḵtalaja)
# اِخْتَلِجَا (iḵtalijā) /ix.ta.li.d͡ʒaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِخْتَلَجَ (iḵtalaja)
